title: Anderson's 2014 commutative algebra problem resolved by Rethlas and Archon
summary: An informal reasoning agent (Rethlas) and a formal verification agent (Archon) resolve an open problem in commutative algebra posed by D. D. Anderson in 2014, as a counterexample. The Lean 4 formalization has about 19,450 lines and was produced in roughly 80 agent hours, with the code public on GitHub. Caveat: arXiv preprint; the Lean check covers the formal statement as written.
ai_technology: Rethlas (informal agent) with Archon (formal Lean agent)
organization: Peking University; Westlake University; Kyoto University; Tianjin University

evidence.tested: The informal proof was formalized and machine-checked in Lean 4 for the formal statement as written.
evidence.unknown: The page describes the case studies as illustrations of capabilities rather than broad evaluations.
evidence.ai_role: Rethlas, an informal reasoning agent, built candidate proofs; Archon, a formal verification agent, translated arguments into Lean 4 projects.
